description: Measure a lease under ASC 842 (v1: the lessee side — real estate and equipment). Give the term, the CERTIFIED discount rate (the rate implicit in the lease, or the incremental borrowing rate — it will NOT assume one), and the payment schedule; it measures the lease liability (present value of the payments), the right-of-use asset (liability + initial direct costs − incentives), and the amortization schedule — a single straight-line lease cost for an operating lease (842-20-25-6) or amortization + interest for a finance lease (842-20-25-5). Usage-based variable payments are excluded from the liability (842-10-30-6). Whatever it can't ground — a missing rate, an undetermined classification — it logs as an OPEN ITEM rather than guessing; lessor accounting is deferred. The result is recorded on the engagement file; a principal signs before the workpapers are delivered.

annual_discount_rate_pct.description: The CERTIFIED annual discount rate (%). Omit and it will ask — it never assumes a rate.

classification.description: The certified classification. Omit to default to operating (the v1 real-estate wedge).

engagement_id.description: The lease engagement (opened via open_engagement, classified as a lease).

incentives_usd.description: Lease incentives received (e.g. a tenant-improvement allowance) — reduces the ROU asset.

initial_direct_costs_usd.description: Initial direct costs — added to the ROU asset.

party.description: v1 is lessee-only; a lessor request is deferred to v2.

payment_timing.description: Whether payments fall at period end (arrears, default) or start (advance).

kind.description: Payment type. usage-based is excluded from the liability (842-10-30-6).

periods_per_year.description: Periods per year: 12 monthly (default), 4 quarterly, 1 annual.

prepaid_usd.description: Payments made at or before commencement — added to the ROU asset.

term_periods.description: The lease term as a number of periods.

name: compute_lease
